description: Compute delta-BSV between predefined groups classes or conditions using absolute BSV summaries rather than residualized spectra
typical_use_case: perturbation panels dose series case-control contrasts concentration series and controlled validations
notes: Differential BSV in GAIRAv3 v2 means delta over absolute BSV outputs. Residualized spectra are explicitly parked as a future experimental idea and are not part of the core lane definition.
